global-store: one machine-wide store shared by every project.

The global location lives under $HOME/.local/share/kb (HOME is $WORK/home in a journey).
A project reaches it with the store ref "global". Outside any project, kb has no location
and says how to make one.

  $ kb --global init --model fake:8
  created location $WORK/home/.local/share/kb/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/home/.local/share/kb (model fake:8)

  $ exists $WORK/home/.local/share/kb/.kb/kb.toml

  $ kb --global add $WORK/notes/shell-tips.md
  added data/shell-tips.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb init --model fake:8
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/tmux.md
  added data/tmux.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb search "history search" --mode fts --caller claude --stores global
  search 1 · 2 hits
  [1] global:data/shell-tips.md · updated 2026-02-01
  Shell history tips: Search your shell history with ctrl-r.

  [2] global:data/shell-tips.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-01
  Shell history tips › (intro)
  # Shell history tips

  Use ctrl-r for history search in the shell.
  search_id=1

  $ kb show global:data/shell-tips.md
  ---
  title: Shell history tips
  summary: Search your shell history with ctrl-r.
  tags: [shell]
  updated: 2026-02-01
  ---
  # Shell history tips

  Use ctrl-r for history search in the shell.

Outside any project there is no location to search.

  $ cd $WORK/elsewhere

  $ kb search "history search" --mode fts
  [stderr] kb search: no kb location found in $WORK/elsewhere or its parents; run "kb init" here, or use --global / --root
  [exit 1]

  $ kb --global search "history search" --mode fts --caller claude
  search 1 · 2 hits
  [1] data/shell-tips.md · updated 2026-02-01
  Shell history tips: Search your shell history with ctrl-r.

  [2] data/shell-tips.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-01
  Shell history tips › (intro)
  # Shell history tips

  Use ctrl-r for history search in the shell.
  search_id=1

A global alias is a store ref in the global kb.toml. The project can use it by name.

  $ cd $WORK/proj

  $ write $WORK/home/.local/share/kb/.kb/kb.toml @globaltoml

  $ kb --global stores
  STORE      MODEL   ENTRIES  DATABASE
  default *  fake:8  1        (size)

  aliases:
    tips  default  -> default@$WORK/home/.local/share/kb

  $ kb search "history search" --mode fts --caller claude --stores tips
  search 2 · 2 hits
  [1] tips:data/shell-tips.md · updated 2026-02-01
  Shell history tips: Search your shell history with ctrl-r.

  [2] tips:data/shell-tips.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-01
  Shell history tips › (intro)
  # Shell history tips

  Use ctrl-r for history search in the shell.
  search_id=2
